features.name: Recently Searched in Tell Me
features.description: In version 29, users can see a list of recent searches they have performed in the Tell Me feature, automatically displayed without needing to type. This helps users quickly access frequently searched pages, reports, and actions they regularly use.
caveats: Limited to pages and reports the user has permission to access
List grows as user explores different pages and reports

features.name: Recently Used Records in Lookups
features.description: A platform-level feature that displays recently used records first when users access lookup fields for customers, vendors, items, GL accounts, and other master records. The system analyzes user signals and surfaces the most relevant records first, personalized for each user.
caveats: Works across all lookup types including custom entities
Users can switch to search menu or select from full list
For first time use, recent section will be blank
Personalized per user based on their usage patterns

quotes.text: This feature focus on helping users to find information faster and reducing repetitive actions during daily work.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core purpose of the two productivity features being discussed in the video.

quotes.text: Going forward in version 29, when a user opens the tell me, user will be able to see searches that he have recently performed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the availability status and functionality of the recently searched feature in version 29.

quotes.text: Now, the same will be available in the advanced search, which is an AI-powered search based on the context that you type.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the recent searches feature also applies to the AI-powered advanced search, not just to standard Tell Me.

quotes.text: The platform analyzes users signal that are already being collected by Business Central and surfaces the most relevant record first.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the intelligent mechanism behind the recently used records feature and how personalization works.
